transcript: Can I make these viral sand stress balls? As the queen of crunchy balls, we have to try this. First, we need a stretchy stress ball skin. And of course, some sand. Let's stretch it onto my reverse squishy pump and inflate that thing like a balloon. Now we can fill it up with my clear shovel. I'm going for five scoops. It's shrinking, so we gotta add more air. Now we need a zip tie to close it. It looks like an uncooked dumpling. As I was closing it, some of the sand was spilling out. It's time to slurp out all of the air with a syringe and needle. It's so hard now. I'll make more crunchy balls in my full video.
